text.desktop: This is a game in progress, on your turn 9. The Dojo moves the cards and keeps the score, but **it doesn't read the cards**. Nothing checks a card's text, its keywords or what it lets you choose. You do, as you would across a real table. **Leave any time with ✕ or Esc.**
text.phone: This is a game in progress, on your turn 9. The Dojo moves the cards and keeps the score, but **it doesn't read the cards**. Nothing checks a card's text, its keywords or what it lets you choose. You do, as you would across a real table. **Leave any time with ✕.**

text.desktop: Your hand holds **The Horseman Strikes!**, which says "Draw a card. You may banish chosen character with Evasive." **Play it. Drag it onto your play area**, or **click it and press Play Card**. The Dojo spends its 3 ink for you.
text.phone: Your hand holds **The Horseman Strikes!**, which says "Draw a card. You may banish chosen character with Evasive." **Play it. Tap it in your hand, then Play.** The Dojo spends its 3 ink for you.

text.desktop: Nothing happened, because you carry out the card's effects. It says draw a card, so **click your deck to draw one**.
text.phone: Nothing happened, because you carry out the card's effects. It says draw a card, so **tap your deck to draw one**.

text.desktop: Now "banish chosen character with Evasive". Which of their characters has Evasive? The Dojo won't tell you, and it won't stop you choosing wrong. **Hover their cards to read them, then banish the one with Evasive.** Hover it and press Banish, or press B.
text.phone: Now "banish chosen character with Evasive". Which of their characters has Evasive? The Dojo won't tell you, and it won't stop you choosing wrong. **Tap their cards to read them, then banish the one with Evasive** with Banish in its drawer.

steps.hint: It's **Vixey**. Evasive is the first word of her text.

wrong.text: The Dojo let you, but that character doesn't have Evasive. Across a real table your opponent would stop you. Here, you're the referee. **Press Undo**, then banish the one with Evasive.

text.desktop: An action stays in play until you put it away. **Send The Horseman Strikes! to your discard. Hover it and press Banish**, or drag it onto your discard pile.
text.phone: An action stays in play until you put it away. **Send The Horseman Strikes! to your discard. Tap it, then Banish.**

steps.text: Now a longer play. You have **6 ink**, Peter Pan and Luisa are ready, and Elinor is in your way. Here is the plan. Quest with Luisa. Use **Magical Maneuvers** to exert Elinor and take Luisa back to your hand. Then shift **Peter Pan & Tinker Bell** onto Peter Pan and challenge Elinor.

text.desktop: **Quest with Luisa Madrigal. Hover her and press the quest lore gem**, or right-click her and choose Quest.
text.phone: **Quest with Luisa Madrigal. Tap her, then Quest.**

text.desktop: **Play Magical Maneuvers** for 2 ink. Drag it onto your play area, or click it and press Play Card. It says "Return chosen character of yours to your hand. Exert chosen character."
text.phone: **Play Magical Maneuvers** for 2 ink. Tap it in your hand, then Play. It says "Return chosen character of yours to your hand. Exert chosen character."

text.desktop: As before, the Dojo doesn't put an action away for you. **Send Magical Maneuvers to your discard yourself.** Hover it and press Banish, or drag it onto your discard pile.
text.phone: As before, the Dojo doesn't put an action away for you. **Send Magical Maneuvers to your discard yourself. Tap it, then Banish.**

text.desktop: Now carry out its effects, one at a time. For "Exert chosen character", **exert Elinor. Hover her and press Exert**, or press E.
text.phone: Now carry out its effects, one at a time. For "Exert chosen character", **exert Elinor. Tap her, then Exert.**

text.desktop: For "Return chosen character of yours to your hand", **right-click Luisa and choose Return to Hand**, or drag her onto your hand. The lore she quested for stays.
text.phone: For "Return chosen character of yours to your hand", **tap Luisa, then To hand.** The lore she quested for stays.

args.card: Peter Pan & Tinker Bell - Fast Friends

text.desktop: **Shift Peter Pan & Tinker Bell onto Peter Pan. Drag it from your hand onto Peter Pan.** The Dojo spends its Shift cost of 4 ink for you. It takes Peter Pan's place, ready and dry.
text.phone: **Shift Peter Pan & Tinker Bell onto Peter Pan. Press it in your hand and drag it onto Peter Pan.** The Dojo spends its Shift cost of 4 ink for you. It takes Peter Pan's place, ready and dry.

args.card: Peter Pan & Tinker Bell - Fast Friends

text.desktop: Elinor is exerted, so she can be challenged. **Drag Peter Pan & Tinker Bell onto Elinor** to challenge her. The forecast shows how it ends before you let go.
text.phone: Elinor is exerted, so she can be challenged. **Drag Peter Pan & Tinker Bell onto Elinor** to challenge her, or tap it, press Challenge, then tap Elinor.

steps.hint: The Dojo would let you challenge a ready character too, or one with Evasive. You keep to the rules.

steps.text: Some cards change lore directly. **A Pirate's Life** says "Each opponent loses 2 lore. You gain 2 lore." Nothing does that for you. **Press + or − beside a player's Lore** to set it, at any time, for any card that asks.
